text: Bitcoin is showing modest strength with a 1% daily gain while Ethereum lags significantly behind at +0.2%, signaling traders are rotating toward perceived safety in the larger asset. The Fear & Greed index remains in fear territory at 33 despite rising 8 points over the week, suggesting cautious sentiment persists even as some conviction returns. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.8% and moderate 24-hour volume of $71B indicate a consolidation phase rather than capitulation or euphoria.
